title: Explicit descending cycle-pullback tower of term functors
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category, $B$ a category, $F:B\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(A,\mathbf Z)$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] a functor, $T:A\to A$ a functor, $\pi:T\to\operatorname{Id}_A$ a natural transformation, and $N\in\mathbf Z$. Put $V_i=F\circ\operatorname{ev}_i$. A stage consists of an integer $n$, functors $C,D:B\to A$, and maps $d:C\to D$, $e:C\to V_n$. The initial stage has $n=N+1$, $C=D=0$, $d=e=0$. A successor has degree $n-1$, current functor $T\circ R$ where $R=V_{n-1}\times_{V_n}\ker d$, next functor $C$, differential $\pi_R$ followed by the second projection and kernel inclusion, and augmentation $\pi_R$ followed by the first projection. Iterate this explicit operation on natural numbers. In integer degree $i\leq N$ take the current functor of stage $(N-i).\operatorname{toNat}+1$; above $N$ take the constant zero functor. Transport the differentials and augmentations along the proved stage-degree and next-term equalities. This defines term functors $X_i$, differentials $\delta_i:X_i\to X_{i+1}$ and augmentations $e_i:X_i\to V_i$ without an existence choice.
